headline: Committee amends Bill 115 deadline, files Bills 122 and 134, defers exemptions item

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.voteItem: Deferral of the real property tax exemptions presentation item
meeting.summary: An amendment setting a new filing deadline in Bill 115 (2024) passed with nine ayes. The committee voted to file Bills 122 and 134 (2024), eight ayes with one member excused, and deferred the real property tax exemptions item with no objections.
meeting.recap: The committee took up Bill 115 (2024), a wildfire-related bill on tax exemption filing deadlines.[[0:08:13]] Current law gives owners renting to people displaced by the wildfire until May 31, 2025 to file.[[0:08:45]] An amendment setting that new deadline passed with nine ayes.[[0:23:45]] A testifier said bed and breakfast permit holders lose all property tax exemptions they would otherwise get.[[0:43:17]] The tax relief item was deferred, or put off to come back later.[[1:21:39]] The draft contract was for analysis of a possible purchase of the East Maui irrigation system.[[1:23:56]] The committee voted to file, or set aside, both bills with eight ayes and one member excused.[[2:23:50]]
decided: The real property tax exemptions item was deferred with no objections.
The committee voted to file Bills 122 and 134 (2024).
meeting.next: Committee staff were asked to draft a policy for a childcare exemption. The chair said she would get back to members about forming a temporary investigative group.

moments.q: "There are no exceptions for missed deadlines."
"I think you should change this to general fund."
